population.naturalStateUniverse: all turn-boundary states visited by the frozen seeded trajectories, including terminal endpoints
population.semanticStateUniverse: natural turn-boundary states plus every one-move legal successor from every nonterminal natural state

localSearchRootSelection.selection: outcome/value/consequence-blind SHA-256 rank over candidateVersion, phase, seed, ply and authoritative RAW key

semanticCollisionWitness.definition: two engine-generated valid states in the semanticStateUniverse have different authoritative RAW keys but the same baseline AI.stateKey

naturalReachableCollisionWitness.definition: two turn-boundary states in the naturalStateUniverse have different authoritative RAW keys but the same baseline AI.stateKey

localEvaluationCacheKeyDomainWitness.definition: within one complete bounded local root expansion, two different authoritative RAW states map to the same baseline AI.stateKey; the baseline evaluation-cache player prefix is constant within one root search

localTranspositionKeyDomainWitness.definition: within one complete bounded local root expansion and the same relative search ply, two different authoritative RAW states map to the same baseline AI.stateKey; with normalizeTtMateScores=false this aliases the baseline AI.stateKey@ply TT identity

workerStaleIdentityWitness.definition: within one natural trajectory, two different turn-boundary authoritative RAW states map to the same baseline AI.stateKey

measurements.importantBoundary: local cache/TT measurements establish same-cache-lifetime key-domain alias support, not an observed production Map hit; actual candidate correctness must be evaluated separately if development is authorized

gate.practicalWitnessDefinition: naturalReachableCollisionWitness OR localEvaluationCacheKeyDomainWitness OR localTranspositionKeyDomainWitness OR workerStaleIdentityWitness
